name: OWASP API Security Top 10 (2023)
description: API-focused checks aligned with the OWASP API Security Top 10 2023.

cases.title: Broken object level authorization
cases.description: Swap object IDs across users and tenants on every endpoint.

cases.title: Broken authentication
cases.description: Token validation, JWT algorithm confusion, credential stuffing protection, token lifetime.

cases.title: Broken object property level authorization
cases.description: Excessive data exposure and mass assignment of protected properties.

cases.title: Unrestricted resource consumption
cases.description: Rate limits, pagination limits, payload size, expensive queries.

cases.title: Broken function level authorization
cases.description: Call admin or privileged functions as a low-privilege user.

cases.title: Unrestricted access to sensitive business flows
cases.description: Automation abuse of purchase, sign-up, referral flows.

cases.title: Server side request forgery
cases.description: URL parameters, webhooks, file imports fetching remote resources.

cases.title: Security misconfiguration
cases.description: CORS, verbose errors, missing TLS, unnecessary HTTP methods.

cases.title: Improper inventory management
cases.description: Old API versions, undocumented endpoints, non-production hosts exposed.

cases.title: Unsafe consumption of APIs
cases.description: Trust placed in third-party API responses and redirects.

cases.title: GraphQL introspection and query depth/complexity
cases.description: Introspection exposure, batching abuse, deep nesting DoS.

cases.title: JWT handling
cases.description: alg=none, weak HMAC secrets, kid injection, missing exp/aud checks.
